title: Lisbon Hills and Riverside
summary: A walkable day through Alfama, central Lisbon, and the Tagus riverfront.

activities.name: Lisbon Cathedral
activities.description: Begin at Lisbon's oldest cathedral before walking into Alfama.

activities.name: Praça do Comércio
activities.description: Explore the monumental riverfront square and nearby arcades.

tips: Wear shoes with good grip for Lisbon's steep, tiled streets.

accommodation_info.transportation_tips: Walk between central stops and use a tram only when needed.

title: Tokyo Gardens and Neon
summary: A balanced Tokyo day pairing a quiet historic garden with Shibuya after dark.

activities.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
activities.description: Take a relaxed morning walk through the garden's varied landscapes.

activities.name: Shibuya Crossing
activities.description: See the crossing at dusk and explore the surrounding streets.

tips: Load a transit card before setting out to simplify train transfers.

accommodation_info.morning_start: Leave from a station on the central rail loop by 08:30.
accommodation_info.evening_return: Plan the return after the evening rush.
accommodation_info.transportation_tips: Rail is the fastest connection between Shinjuku and Shibuya.

title: New York Park to Skyline
summary: Classic Manhattan sights from Central Park to an evening skyline viewpoint.

activities.name: Central Park Bethesda Terrace
activities.description: Walk the park paths to Bethesda Terrace and the lake.
activities.address: 72 Terrace Dr, New York, NY 10024, United States

activities.name: Top of the Rock
activities.description: Time an observation-deck visit for sunset over Manhattan.
activities.address: 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10112, United States

tips: Reserve timed observation-deck admission before the day of your visit.

accommodation_info.morning_start: Start near a subway line serving the Upper West or East Side.
accommodation_info.evening_return: Allow extra time for busy Midtown stations after sunset.
accommodation_info.transportation_tips: Use the subway for the long leg and walk within each neighborhood.
